title: Complete transport instructions whose permitted safe choices all satisfy the later written clauses
summary: RAW_UNREVIEWED_NOT_SELECTED. Distinguish a complete executable instruction from a reported successful path: every load left unspecified by RETURN_EXCLUDING, provided it is physically available and immediately safe, must permit the remaining written instructions and reach the written final goal. The original full transport paragraph has a unique feasible execution and remains a positive starting candidate. A paired f50 instruction remains an open whole-reading hypothesis under unchanged original dictionaries and the existing extension domains; no robust f50 reading has been demonstrated here. Two saved FULL15 branches show why this new law differs from old existential success, without refuting the whole open extension family.

new_meaning_assumption.claim: The text gives sufficient sequential directions: after any presently permitted choice, following the rest of the written directions succeeds. It does not merely report a successful run or ask a solver to find one by looking ahead.
new_meaning_assumption.reason_it_is_new: GDT993 explicitly leaves instructions versus reported plan unseparated. The frozen executor enumerates RETURN_EXCLUDING choices, while GDT1013 accepts existence of at least one consistent full path. Full instruction adequacy introduces a universal dependency between an earlier underspecified command and all later explicit commands/assertions.
new_meaning_assumption.serious_rival: An intelligent actor may use the final goal, later commands or unstated practical knowledge to choose one globally successful load. A narration may mention only that successful choice. Those readings need only existential success and are not irrational or malformed. The manuscript has no independently identified imperative or no-lookahead marker; this stronger instructional meaning is an explicit new assumption.
new_meaning_assumption.no_unwritten_policy: Do not add a cargo-name preference, shortest-path criterion, minimal load default, lookahead oracle or per-occurrence choice table. The proposal limits what the written instructions may leave open rather than fitting a new choice policy.

reusable_choice_operation.inputs: The current complete physical state, the locally introduced cargo set, the resolved excluded cargo x, and the fixed positive hazard graph of that same complete paragraph. Agent/vehicle location, capacity and cargo co-location are inherited. Reference resolution remains the frozen written-order rule and does not depend on successful outcomes.
reusable_choice_operation.candidate_loads: For EXCLUDING(x), begin with empty and each locally introduced cargo at the agent's current bank except x. Keep only loads that permit this actual interbank move and whose resulting state obeys all declared local hazards and any currently applicable written obligation. Full-paragraph positive hazard declarations have their original global-in-that-paragraph scope. Never import a cargo or another paragraph's hazard.
reusable_choice_operation.all_choice_law: At every reached prefix, every such currently admissible choice must preserve executability and all later assertions and eventually the stated goal. A reached command with no permissible successor is failure, not vacuous success. Fixed-load commands still have to execute physically and safely. The execution is finite in the written command order; no fairness or unbounded policy issue is introduced.
reusable_choice_operation.critical_quantifier: For all locally permissible choices, the entire remaining written suffix succeeds. Future cargo availability, STAY/RESULT assertions or final-goal truth may expose a bad choice; they may not be used to delete that earlier choice before the universal check. Doing so would collapse the proposal back into the existing existential reading.
reusable_choice_operation.local_safety_scope: An immediately unsafe load is already forbidden by the written SAFETY meaning and is not the discriminating bad choice. The concrete FULL15 counterbranches below are physically available and have no safety violations before their later failure. This avoids a strawman which demands that an instruction permit conduct it explicitly forbids.
reusable_choice_operation.degree_of_new_freedom: Zero new word meanings, symbol values, productions, thresholds, physical state variables, hidden actions or fitted policies. Add one global universal-versus-existential semantic commitment. Existing71/75new whole-word aliases and complete parse choices remain extensive freedom; this law does not explain productive word formation.

positive_starting_construction.existing_complete_original: In the GDT993 surviving full paragraph, the first trip carries G; at S07 RETURN_EXCLUDING(G), only G is at the return bank and is excluded, so the only available load is empty. Every later load is explicitly fixed, including RETURN ALONE at S15. The published report records exactly one path for each original variant, with the four retained variants fully consistent. Thus the original full reading is not destroyed merely by replacing existential adequacy with the proposed universal adequacy.
positive_starting_construction.anonymous_cargo_extension: For the later36dictionary/156setting original family, qokedy is the central cargo and the same written first-trip/exclusion structure supplies the analogous forced-empty return. This is a prospective structural deduction to verify, not a newly executed156case result.
positive_starting_construction.positive_added_scope_not_claimed: No saved f50 witness has been certified universally successful in this production task, and no new extension was constructed or executed. The unchanged finite grammar includes fully specified return and load constructions; there is no shown general contradiction of the proposed whole extension family. Root should retain this as an open positive candidate only if a bounded search can actually exhibit a complete added reading, not because the original alone works.

two_actual_reused_cells.why_empty_is_not_the_rival: Empty leaves the declared dangerous G/W pair unattended atR; it is excluded already by local safety.
two_actual_reused_cells.successful_output: Return G. The saved successful full path later brings C out, then returns W atS14 and ultimately reaches the complete goal.
two_actual_reused_cells.competing_output: Return W. The separately saved path remains safe, then brings C out atS13; S14 explicitly attempts to return W, which is now atL while the agent is atR. Existing stored result: physical_failure atS14 CARGO_NOT_AT_AGENT(W), safety_violations=[].
two_actual_reused_cells.new_consequence: One locally safe unresolved choice makes a later fully specified command impossible; the fixed FULL15 dictionary/parse is not a sufficient instruction under this law.

two_actual_reused_cells.input: The same FULL15/primary EXCLUDING(C) atS26, zero-based source groups[44,46), after the saved successful choice atS08.
two_actual_reused_cells.successful_output: Return empty, then the final written outward trip carries W and all cargo end atR.
two_actual_reused_cells.competing_output: Return G. The final written outward trip still carries W, leaving G atL. Existing stored result: physical_complete=true, safety_violations=[], goal_reached=false, FINAL_LOCAL_ASSERTION_FALSE atS45.
two_actual_reused_cells.new_consequence: The same open return operation has a different safe choice set here; an allowed G load preserves physical executability but contradicts the explicitly written complete result. This is a second consequence of the one choice law, not a second fitted policy.

known_countercases_and_limits.retain_FULL15: The complete11voyage FULL15 existential witness and its two saved counterbranches remain unchanged. The stronger instructional candidate rejects that fixed witness if its reported states/choices are verified; this does not revoke its GDT1013 positive or exclude alternative added lexicons.
known_countercases_and_limits.against_a_report_only_story: The final all-cargo claim can truthfully report the one successful path even when a different locally safe choice would fail. Universal adequacy cannot be inferred just from an explicit final claim.
known_countercases_and_limits.strongest_semantic_countercase: Ordinary procedural prose can intentionally leave a choice to a user who reads ahead. If that is the manuscript's intended instruction semantics, the universal local-choice law is too strong. No generic rule about all imperatives is asserted.
known_countercases_and_limits.freedom_and_nonseparation: The added whole-word aliases may encode every return with a fixed load or ALONE, making the proposed law trivially true for all retained originals. That outcome would preserve positive complete worlds but close this particular restriction as nonseparating; it would not identify an instruction word.
known_countercases_and_limits.scientific_ceiling: All contents remain hypothetical, exposed, and source-uncertain. No named cargo, source work, actual instruction genre or word translation is established. Confirmed words0.

smallest_decision_changing_plan.stage1: After root selection and registration, check the universal rule on complete saved old and added witnesses with their existing aliases/parses fixed. Validate allowed choices from each predecessor state, retaining currently safe failed prefixes and final failures; do not classify by count of consistent paths alone. A robust complete original-plus-added pair is already a constructive positive and can be published without a new decoder.
smallest_decision_changing_plan.stage2_gate: If saved witnesses fail but the original contract is coherent, no original dictionary exclusion follows. Root may separately authorize a bounded full search over the same finite extension family, adding universal reachable-prefix constraints; no automatic chain of fresh dictionaries or repairs. Do not promote this card merely from the known FULL15 failure.
smallest_decision_changing_plan.finite_search_shape: The written order is acyclic and the old physical state is finite. A candidate implementation can propagate all locally safe reachable states at every chosen clause boundary and reject a bad fixed-load action or asserted consequence from ANY reachable prefix. State must retain every old executor field needed by STAY, RESULT and FINAL; merging solely by cargo locations is insufficient. Independent forward replay validates complete positives. A timeout remains UNKNOWN.
smallest_decision_changing_plan.outcomes: A complete robust pair supports only this conditional stronger instruction candidate. Proper subset exclusion requires exhaustive whole extension search, not failed saved witnesses. If every original still has a robust extension, close the law as nonseparating. If no full pair survives exhaustively, reject the strengthened instructional conjunction, preserving the old reported-plan/existential readings.
smallest_decision_changing_plan.budget_scope: Inclusive registration, bounded integration, independent validation and publication if selected. At budget expiry report only established witness/search scope; no automatic increase. A separate full-search implementation is unwarranted if root judges the instruction assumption scientifically unhelpful.
